sections.section_title: RTC alarm A binary mode register (RTC_ALRABINR)
sections.text_helper: Section 61.6.24 "RTC alarm A binary mode register (RTC_ALRABINR)" in chapter 61 (Real-time clock (RTC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3053.
sections.section_content:
This register can be written only when ALRAE is reset in RTC_CR register.
This register can be protected against nonsecure access. Refer to Section61.3.4: RTC
secure protection modes.
This register can be protected against unprivileged access. Refer to Section61.3.5: RTC
privilege protection modes.
Address offset: 0x70
Backup domain reset value: 0x0000 0000
System reset: not affected
Bits 31:0 SS[31:0]: Synchronous counter alarm value
This value is compared with the contents of the synchronous counter to determine if Alarm A
is to be activated. Only bits 0 up MASKSS-1 are compared.
SS[14:0] is the mirror of SS[14:0] in the RTC_ALRMASSR, and so can also be read or
written through RTC_ALRMASSR.
